summary: Verified diagnostic logging changes for Electron '操作失敗' bug. Web preview regression check passed: app loads, game creation via UI works without error toast, backend 13/13 pytest passing. All diagnostic code (electronAdapter verbose logs, App.js IPC startup test, main.js F12 shortcut + auto-openDevTools, preload.js try/catch, detailed error toasts in Sidebar/TasksView/HistoryView/SettingsView) is correctly in place. Note: Electron desktop app itself cannot be run in this Linux env - diagnostic build is ready for user to test on their machine.

issues: Missing DialogContent Description / aria-describedby (a11y warning, non-blocking)

action_items: User must rebuild the .exe (yarn build in frontend + electron-builder) and re-run. DevTools will open automatically; capture the [ElectronAdapter]/[Preload]/[IPC] logs and the enhanced 操作失敗 detail from the toast to identify root cause.
Once root cause is confirmed and fixed, consider removing the default openDevTools({mode:'detach'}) in /app/desktop/main.js so production users don't see DevTools by default.
critical_code_review_comments: electronAdapter.js: correctly overrides axios adapter only when window.electronAPI is present; IPC errors are wrapped with meaningful message.
main.js: openDevTools({mode:'detach'}) is unconditional in production - fine for diagnosis, must be removed post-debug.
preload.js: try/catch around contextBridge is defensive but exposeInMainWorld rarely throws; still acceptable.
All 4 component error toasts consistently use error?.response?.data?.detail || error?.response?.data?.error || error?.message pattern - good.
seed_data_creation: Created one test game 'TEST_Game_*' via web UI during smoke test (persisted in Mongo).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Diagnostic-only change verified. No functional regression in web preview. Electron behaviour (the actual bug context) cannot be exercised in this container - only file-level verification is possible. If user reports new logs from their Electron run, main agent should analyze those logs (from [ElectronAdapter]/[IPC]/[Preload] prefixes) to pinpoint the failure.
